summary: Ranked, unexecuted next goals after Round32 (AV1-AZ2). Every goal is a fixed-lattice, fixed-coupling question with a named missing premise; none is a fraction of the continuum problem. Goals 1-4 come from the AY2 obligations table; goal 5 from the AZ1 statement (to be confirmed at its gate).
ranking_basis: Ranked by how much of the missing premise is already available in admitted constants (AM2, AQ1, AY1) and by the smallest exact certificate that would change a gate field from false to true within scope.

goals.title: Uniqueness of the local restriction of subsequential limits at the cap
goals.target: Prove that any two subsequential limits of the named families agree on R (not only within 2D), by an HTW-type local stability or a Dobrushin-type uniqueness condition with evaluated constants at |tau|<=10^-8.
goals.missing_premise: The Yarotsky constants c_1(S), c_2(S) cited in I1 are existential; no evaluated two-state estimate exists. AY2 records the falsifying scenario the present bounds cannot exclude.
goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Evaluate a Dobrushin-type interdependence matrix for the AM2 fixed point with J=28|tau| and the 21-face stars on a small centered box and check whether its norm is below one at the cap; if it is, derive a two-state estimate on R.
limitations: A failed Dobrushin condition is not evidence of non-uniqueness.
Uniqueness on R is not translation invariance.

goals.title: Boundary independence of dynamics on compact time windows
goals.target: Compare the Heisenberg dynamics of A in B(H_R) between the centered and padded families on a compact time window by a Lieb-Robinson/Duhamel argument with the AQ1 Nachtergaele-Sims constants (F(r)=(1+r)^-4, C<=224, ||Phi||_F<=2268|tau|, ||Phi'||_F<=1323|tau|) over the 28N(5N+1) extra boundary faces at distance N-1.
goals.missing_premise: No dynamics is constructed for the padded family (AY2 obligation rows 5 and 6); an O(N^-2)-type Duhamel bound is expected but unproved.
goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Apply Nachtergaele-Sims Theorem 4.1 to the padded owner-set interaction and bound the boundary contribution on [0, T] with T=1 in the common clock; exact constants only.
limitations: A dynamics comparison is not a statement about the infinite-volume dynamics beyond R.

goals.title: Whole-sequence convergence and a rate in N
goals.target: A Cauchy estimate in N for the R-marginal of the finite-box ground vectors of one family, giving convergence of the whole sequence and an explicit rate.
goals.missing_premise: The admitted constants are uniform in N but carry no decay of boundary influence; a decay factor for the AM2 fixed point under a boundary change is missing.
goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Bound ||rho_R^{(N)} - rho_R^{(N+1)}||_1 through the creation expansion restricted to supports touching the boundary shell and the R-vacuum ordering of AV1.
limitations: A rate in N is not a rate in a.

goals.title: Sharper R-local second-order constant
goals.target: Reduce K_2' (about 13418) by replacing the per-site AM2 remainder 4 rho with an R-local remainder that tracks which creations can reach R at second order.
goals.missing_premise: AY1 shows 99.99% of K_2' is the per-site AM2 remainder, which face restriction cannot reduce; a second-order expansion of the fixed point itself (not its majorant) on R is missing.
goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Compute the exact second-order coefficient c^(2) restricted to R on a small box and compare with the majorant.
limitations: A smaller constant does not change any gate field.

goals.title: One uniform-in-a estimate along a named trajectory
goals.target: Identify a single estimate that could be uniform along a trajectory (a_n, g_n) with g_n -> 0 and state exactly which premise of the strong-coupling contraction it would replace.
goals.missing_premise: The AM2 contraction needs tau=96/g^4<=10^-8, violated on every g->0 path; the AL1 bridge condition g^4>=32 also fails (AZ1 statement).
goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Statement loop only: no candidate uniform-in-a estimate is known to this programme; record any audited external construction as a lead.
limitations: No number in this repository is a fraction of the continuum problem.

methods_decision: Continue with paired producers for new derivations, single+skeptic for replays of admitted formulas on a changed model, statement+skeptic for statements; every contract carries the pre-registration block with both vocabulary extensions.
stop_boundary: Round32 scientific production stopped after AZ2 (investigation 10 of 10). This roadmap is planned only; nothing here is executed or admitted.
